citation.title: Acute high-cocoa flavanol intake and cognitive fatigue during aerobic exercise with prolonged cognitive load (crossover; low-flavanol arm entered)

population.description: Eighteen healthy males, 22 +/- 2 years (range 20-25), height 172.5 +/- 6.7 cm, body mass 65.6 +/- 4.7 kg, VO2peak 46 +/- 4 mL/kg/min; free from neurological, cardiovascular or pulmonary disorders, no medication, nonsmokers. BMI is not printed, so left null. The paper does not report glucose tolerance testing; 'healthy' is the paper's own word.

protocols.name: lcf_fasted_rest
protocols.description: Low-cocoa-flavanol (LCF, 50 mg, control) trial, morning visit after a 12 h food abstention. Minute 0 is arrival (cannula inserted). 10 min rest then a 5-min Stroop task, so the baseline HR, BP and blood sample is taken from about minute 15 (window 15-16, derived: 10 + 5 min). The LCF capsule (50 mg flavanol; the paper prints no other contents, so entered as no meal) is then given, and the second resting sample is 1 h after it: minute 15 + 60 = 75 (window 75-76; the time the baseline measures took is not printed and taken as zero). The 50-min cycling bout that follows is not entered because every post-exercise number that is a mean +/- SD is a marker the model does not carry.
